crossRefs.note: You can catch a lizard with your hands, yet it is in kings’ palaces.

translations.web: You can catch a lizard with your hands, yet it is in kings’ palaces.
translations.bsb: and the lizard can be caught in one’s hands, yet it is found in the palaces of kings.
translations.kjv: The spider taketh hold with her hands, and is in kings' palaces.
translations.asv: The lizard taketh hold with her hands, Yet is she in kings' palaces.
